_form: Form 8949 - Sales and Other Dispositions of Capital Assets
_notes: Page 1 = Part I (Short-Term). Page 2 = Part II (Long-Term). Same field structure on both pages but prefixed f1_ (page 1) and f2_ (page 2). Transaction rows repeat every 8 field numbers. Root prefix: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0] or Page2[0].

_BOX_TYPE_CHECKBOXES_PAGE1.c1_1[0]: Box A - Short-term, basis reported to IRS (/1)
_BOX_TYPE_CHECKBOXES_PAGE1.c1_1[1]: Box B - Short-term, basis NOT reported to IRS (/2)
_BOX_TYPE_CHECKBOXES_PAGE1.c1_1[2]: Box C - Short-term, Form 1099-B not received (/3)

_BOX_TYPE_CHECKBOXES_PAGE2.c2_1[0]: Box D - Long-term, basis reported to IRS (/1)
_BOX_TYPE_CHECKBOXES_PAGE2.c2_1[1]: Box E - Long-term, basis NOT reported to IRS (/2)
_BOX_TYPE_CHECKBOXES_PAGE2.c2_1[2]: Box F - Long-term, Form 1099-B not received (/3)

_TRANSACTION_ROWS_PAGE1._pattern: Each row has 8 columns. Row fields use RowN[0].f1_XX[0] where XX increments by 8 per row.
_TRANSACTION_ROWS_PAGE1.Row1[0].f1_05[0]: Row 1 col (c) - Date sold or disposed (MM/DD/YYYY)
_TRANSACTION_ROWS_PAGE1.Row1[0].f1_07[0]: Row 1 col (e) - Cost or other basis
_TRANSACTION_ROWS_PAGE1.Row1[0].f1_08[0]: Row 1 col (f) - Adjustment code (B=basis adj, W=wash sale)
_TRANSACTION_ROWS_PAGE1.Row1[0].f1_10[0]: Row 1 col (h) - Gain or loss (d + g - e)
_TRANSACTION_ROWS_PAGE1._row_pattern: Row N uses fields f1_((N-1)*8 + 3) through f1_((N-1)*8 + 10). Max 14 rows.

_TOTALS_PAGE1.f1_95[0]: Totals col (h) - Total gain or loss

_COMMON_ADJUSTMENT_CODES.B: Basis reported to IRS is incorrect (e.g., ESPP disqualifying disposition where W-2 income not reflected in 1099-B basis)
_COMMON_ADJUSTMENT_CODES.W: Wash sale - loss disallowed (add positive amount to increase basis)
_COMMON_ADJUSTMENT_CODES.T: Short-term trade reported on 1099-B but actually long-term
